greeting.speaker: FLOWEY
greeting.dialogue: * Hmm...\n* You're new to the underground-\d[15]\sk

greeting.speaker: SUSIE
greeting.dialogue: * Great. A talking dandelion.\n  Move, weed, we're walking\n  here.

greeting.speaker: FLOWEY
greeting.dialogue: * Hey! No need to be rude.\n* I was just greeting the\n  human to the underground.

greeting.speaker: FLOWEY
greeting.dialogue: * As I was saying, you\n  must be so confused.

greeting.speaker: FLOWEY
greeting.dialogue: * Somebody's ought to teach\n  you how things work around here!

greeting.speaker: SUSIE
greeting.dialogue: * Look, we don't give a crap\n  about anything you're gonna\n  say.

greeting.speaker: FLOWEY
greeting.dialogue: * But doesn't the human want\n  to learn about their \c[yellow]SOUL\c[white]?\n* About their \c[yellow]LOVE\c[white]?

greeting.speaker: SUSIE
greeting.dialogue: * Why the hell would we care?

greeting.speaker: FLOWEY
greeting.dialogue: * The underground is full of dangerous\n  monsters. The human needs to\n  learn how to defend themselves.

greeting.speaker: SUSIE
greeting.dialogue: * A dumb little flower teaching\n  self-defense? I don't have\n  time for this.

heated_up.speaker: FLOWEY
heated_up.dialogue: * \sp[2]\s[0.5]You think you can talk to\n  me like that, you IDIOT?!

heated_up.speaker: SUSIE
heated_up.dialogue: * Wow. Gross face. Change it\n  back before I step on you.

heated_up.speaker: FLOWEY
heated_up.dialogue: * \s[0.5]What? WHO do you think\n  you ARE?

heated_up.speaker: SUSIE
heated_up.dialogue: * You're nowhere near as\n  intimidating as you think.

heated_up.speaker: FLOWEY
heated_up.dialogue: * Look, I might look like a\n  flower, but-\d[15]\sk

pre_battle.speaker: SUSIE
pre_battle.dialogue: * FINE!! If it will get you\n  to SHUT UP, hurry up and show us.

post_battle.speaker: SUSIE
post_battle.dialogue: * I knew something was up\n  with that flower.

post_battle.speaker: SUSIE
post_battle.dialogue: * What the hell have we\n  gotten ourselves into?
